title: Niagara Falls Boat Cruise and Journey Behind the Falls Tour
includes: Guided Tour of Niagara Falls Canada with a local guide
Niagara City Cruises Boat Ride (Admission Included) (May - December)
Seasonal Boat Replacement: Niagara Takes Flight Ride (January - April)
Skip-the-Ticket-Line: Journey Behind the Falls (Admission Included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: Niagara Takes Flight is not accessible to infants or children under 100 cm.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See Niagara Falls, Canada like never before on this unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime tour that brings you closer to the natural wonder than you ever imagined. From breathtaking viewpoints to thrilling attractions, you’ll witness the incredible power, beauty, and majesty of the Falls up close. Whether it's the roar of the water, the mist on your face, or the unforgettable sights along the way, this is an experience you truly don’t want to miss!
